title: The Prestige
author: RJBlarmo
rules:
In this puzzle, there is a deck of 52 cards, consisting of the numbers 1-13 in 4 colors each (red, green, blue, and pink). 2 unknown cards have vanished from the deck, and the remaining 50 must be placed into the grid according to the following rules:

Ciphered Japanese Sums: Clues outside a row or column give the sums of the colored runs in that row or column in order. Runs in the same row or column must be separated by at least one empty cell. Each of the 10 cipher letters represents a distinct digit from 0-9, and multi-letter clues cannot begin with 0.

Numbers (1-13) cannot repeat in any row or column. All cells of the same color must form an orthogonally connected region. Cells of different colors cannot touch orthogonally. There is a unique rule that applies to cells of each color:

• Red (Alternating Parity): Orthogonally adjacent red cells must have opposite even/odd parity.

• Green (German Whispers): Orthogonally adjacent green cells must differ by at least 5.

• Blue (No Busting): Every horizontal or vertical run of blue cells must have a sum of at most 21.

• Pink (Straights on Straights): Every horizontal or vertical run of pink cells must form a set of consecutive numbers in any order.

Solve online: Penpa+
solutionCode: The ciphered Japanese Sums clues for Row 6 and Column 7 (no spaces).
